description: [S1.2, kind `port`] chooseShotTarget's strict flag [F+0xb4] is never initialised (first store 0x00423b0e, read 0x00423b20). The oracle and the port start it at 0 (the zero-filled emulated stack, U-0880). In the live game it holds whatever an earlier frame left in that stack word, so a first strict scan can run with a nonzero value before any landing stored it, and the ON / OFF difference of this step then also depends on the stack content the caller left. Not measured live.
path to resolution: a live trace of the dword at esp+0xb4 at 0x00423b20 on the first scan of each search (call log or Frida read on the game thread), or the callers' frame history from 0x00422fb0's call sites

description: [S1.2, kind `port`] The oracle replaces pumpInput483bd0 (called at 0x00423fb2 once per pruning step) by a `ret`, as the port drops it (U-0881). With no display object in the state, the real pump dereferences g_display (0x00483bbf load, 0x00483bc5 read: UC_ERR_READ_UNMAPPED at 0x00483bc5 in the first run on seed 4). The pump's own writes to simulation state are not part of this comparison; they are the same for the ON and OFF arms of the port, so the switch's effect is unaffected.
path to resolution: run the original with a fake display object whose slot +0x128 returns 0 (the pump loops while that returns nonzero) and compare the image; or the C3 A/B of pumpInput483bd0

description: [S1.2, kind `evidence`] The pinned states are synthetic (a random tile grid, one golfer, a hole 3 to 13 tiles from the ball); no recorded scenario reaches an ON / OFF difference (U-1012: 200 segments equal, 480 mutants equal). 42 of 700 swept states differ, so the defect is reachable from legal tile types and a golfer with the slope preference bit (golfer byte +0x19 bit 2), but how often a real course gives two landings with the second failing the strict condition is not established. The prune-tolerance mode (negctl 5) stays blind on these states.
path to resolution: a scenario or a played round whose search shows ON != OFF (count the sticky reads with the call log), or a wider state family that keeps cells in the 0x40..0x80 score band after pass 1
